name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
summary: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities in order to elevate privileges. Exploitation of a software vulnerability occurs when an adversary takes advantage of a programming error in an application, service, within the operating system software, or kernel itself to execute adversary-controlled code. strategies.name: Detection of Exploitation for Privilege Escalation

analytics.name: Analytic 1758
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Exploitation for Privilege Escalation by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed.
